crossRefs.note: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

people.name: Cauda
people.line: Island where Paul's ship sought shelter

translations.web: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.
translations.bsb: Passing to the lee of a small island called Cauda, we barely managed to secure the lifeboat.
translations.kjv: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
